description: This file defines template classes for serializing various std::map-based data structures such as AddressMap, RangeMap, and ContainedRangeMap, used in the breakpad processor component.

classes.name: StdMapSerializer
classes.description: Template class for serializing std::map objects.

classes.name: AddressMapSerializer
classes.description: Serializer for AddressMap objects, wrapping StdMapSerializer.

classes.name: RangeMapSerializer
classes.description: Serializer for RangeMap objects, handling range-based data.

classes.name: ContainedRangeMapSerializer
classes.description: Serializer for ContainedRangeMap objects, handling maps with contained ranges.

methods.name: SizeOf
methods.description: Calculates the size of serialized data for the respective map type.

methods.name: Write
methods.description: Serializes the map data into a provided memory buffer.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Serializes the map into a new memory buffer and returns it.
